findings.title: FORMAT.md section 3 manifest example still shows an old-style id ("a1b2c3"), contradicting the new f<N> scheme
findings.fix: Change the example id to the reference scheme, e.g. "id": "f0", and add this example fix to the Change-1 FORMAT.md edit list so the normative f<N> prose and the example agree (FORMAT.md is the source of truth, INV-1).

findings.title: Create-time set_attributes_mtime call site and create-only gating are unspecified
findings.where: design.md Change 3 (count-0 mtime) and cmd_add.rs run-loop wiring
findings.fix: After add_at(...) in the run loop, call archive.set_attributes_mtime(&source.name, &source.ts) ONLY when !was_tracked (the flag the loop already computes), reusing the pre-formatted source.ts rather than re-reading a path. State that cmd_update.rs needs no such call because update cannot create (errors NotTracked on an absent name).

findings.title: Multi-version file with a stamp-less current record falls back to the older create-time attributes.mtime
findings.fix: Acceptable as-is (best-effort, better than '-'). Optionally drop the attributes.mtime fallback when the file has >= 1 record if the owner prefers '-' over a stale create-time value. No change required.
